meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Use the public `orca` CLI to operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, worktree comments, and the browser embedded inside the Orca app. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "use orca cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "cardStatus", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "terminal send", "full handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", "share HTML/Markdown", "public artifact link", or "control the browser inside Orca". Prefer this over raw `git worktree`, ad hoc PTYs, Playwright, or Computer Use when the task touches Orca-managed state. Use Computer Use for browser windows, webviews, or desktop UI outside Orca's embedded browser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 统管多个开发工作区,交接任务给其他 AI 助手
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在多个开发工作区里同时跑 AI 助手,常需要任务交接。
copy.tagline_en: Manage multiple dev worktrees and hand off tasks between AI assistants.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use several AI assistants across dev worktrees and often pass work between them.

howto.what: Claude 会调用 Orca 的命令行工具来管理代码工作区、终端、嵌入式浏览器等，并在操作前先获取当前版本的使用手册，避免用错命令。
howto.when: 当用户提到“$orca-cli”“use orca cli”等关键词，或要求操作 Orca 工作树、终端、浏览器、工件等功能时触发；涉及 Orca 管理状态时优先使用。

say.text: 用 orca cli 查看当前工作树状态。
say.note: 会返回 Orca 管理的 worktree 列表与状态。

say.text: 在 Orca 终端里运行 git status。
say.note: 会在 Orca 管理的终端中执行并回传结果。

say.text: 把这个任务完整移交给另一个 worktree 的 agent。
say.note: 执行 full handoff 交接。

howto.what_en: Claude will use the Orca CLI to manage Orca-managed worktrees, terminals, embedded browser, etc., and fetch the version-matched guide before running commands to avoid wrong usage.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says keywords like "$orca-cli" or "use orca cli", or asks to operate Orca worktrees, terminals, browser, artifacts; preferred when Orca-managed state is involved.

say_en.text: Use orca cli to check the current worktree status.
say_en.note: Returns Orca-managed worktree list and status.

say_en.text: Run git status in the Orca terminal.
say_en.note: Executes in the Orca-managed terminal and reports back.

say_en.text: Hand this task over to another agent in another worktree.
